subject: How to invoke parameters in parnfluence which are named parameters?

messages.author: 1e94001192669559
messages.subject: How to invoke parameters in parnfluence which are named parameters?
parts:
Dear kind all:
I'm attemptingn to use the parinfluence function in the influence.SEM package. (both lavaan and influence.SEM are up to date.
I have named a parameter for a factor loading in the following example "L4" for example. 
However, when attempting to invoke parinfluence with the following, it can't seem to find the parameter:
/*
LY <- parinfluence("Slope=~wisc4",model,modelData)
explore.influence(LY$Dparm[1,])
explore.influence(LY$gCD[1,])
*/
When I edit out the parameter names, the code runs fine. I've not been successful identifying any documentation or example code. Has anyone encountered this? thanks! Phil

/*Here's the model in case you're curious 
model<-"
! regressions 
   Int=~1.0*wisc1
   Int=~1.0*wisc2
   Int=~1.0*wisc3
   Int=~1.0*wisc4
   Slope=~L1*wisc1
   Slope=~L2*wisc2
   Slope=~L3*wisc3
   Slope=~ L4*wisc4 
! residuals, variances and covariances
   wisc1 ~~ e1*wisc1
   wisc2 ~~ e1*wisc2
   wisc3 ~~ e3*wisc3
   wisc4 ~~ e4*wisc4
   Int ~~ VAR_Int*Int
   Slope ~~ 1.0*Slope
   Int ~~ 0.0*Slope
! means
   Int~1
   Slope~1
   wisc1~0*1;
   wisc2~0*1;
   wisc3~0*1;
   wisc4~0*1;
";
